definitions: A mark or a series of marks left by a person, animal, or object moving through an area.
A path or track made across a rough country.
A series of clues or a course of events leading to a particular discovery or situation.
The scent left by a person or animal, used for tracking.
examples: A trail of footprints in the snow.
They followed the trail through the forest.
The police were on the trail of the suspect.
The dog picked up the trail of the fox.
